action.hint: To remove it, adopt it first.

page.title: Adopt {{name}}
page.body: Coaming builds a compose definition from what's running on {{env}}, checks it, and then manages the stack. Adopting doesn't change anything that is running.

envValues.title: Environment values are copied in as they are
envValues.body: That includes passwords. Move secret values to Variables after adopting. Secrets and configs that already exist stay as they are and are referenced as external.

footer.nothing: Nothing changes on {{env}} until your first deploy.

error.stale: What is running on {{env}} changed since the check. Run the check again before you adopt.
error.lost: Coaming couldn't reach the server. Nothing was changed. Check the connection and try again.
error.permission: You need the Admin role on {{env}} to adopt a stack.

gone.heading: This stack is gone
gone.body: It was removed outside Coaming, or it is now managed. Go back to the list to find it.

loadFailed.title: Couldn't check {{name}} against what's running.
loadFailed.body: Check the connection and try again. Nothing was changed.
